provenance: Original source written for this library.
describes: A cheerful idle character beside a headline. The character does nothing that causes or answers an event, so it is decoration, not storytelling.
expected_reason: beat 'cheer': the action phase is only idle/breathe/blink
why_this_matters: The profile only counts anticipate -> act -> react. A breathing mascot next to a title does not qualify for the cel-boil profile; use plain typography or a different medium if no event is worth acting out. Also: the headline must never be boiled; boil applies to the character's linework only.
limitations: the headline is a separate evidence/type layer and is not part of this module
